AnalysisConsumptionOut.description:
What the uses of a person consumed in one analysis. `measured` are the uses that were (the others add
nothing).
AnalysisConsumptionOut.title: AnalysisConsumptionOut

AnalysisOut.description:
An analysis. One the person cannot open is only named, with its date and how it is going: the rest (who made it,
what it is for, its uses, its recipients) is empty.
AnalysisOut.title: AnalysisOut

ClassificationOut.description:
What something could be, and how sure the analysis is (0 to 1); no model is « other ». For a page of the
document, the page of the model it looks like (« form X, page 3 »).
ClassificationOut.title: ClassificationOut

ConsumptionOut.description:
What computing something consumed: the electricity (Wh), the CO2 it made (g), the water it cost (mL, estimated
from the electricity) and the time it took (s).
ConsumptionOut.title: ConsumptionOut

LinkOut.description: A link between two nodes: `page-N` is the page N of the document, any other is a neighbour (`<model>:<page>`).
LinkOut.title: LinkOut

ModelQuality.description: The quality on one model, among the decisions of a person or of everyone.
ModelQuality.title: ModelQuality

MyConsumptionOut.description:
What all the uses of a person consumed, and the detail by analysis, the most consuming first; and, apart, what
their searches for similar documents consumed.
MyConsumptionOut.title: MyConsumptionOut

NeighbourOut.description:
A page of a model of the catalogue that looks like a page of the document. `document_id` is the example document
of the model that was looked at (a model has had several: each version X has its own), to show the right image.
NeighbourOut.title: NeighbourOut

OcrLine.description: A line of text and where it is on the page as it was given: the four corners, from 0 to 1.
OcrLine.title: OcrLine

PageFields.description:
A name and a description of a page of a model's document; both are optional (without a name a page is the name
of the model and its number).
PageFields.title: PageFields

PageOut.description: What one page of the document tried could be, and what was decided of it.
PageOut.title: PageOut

Quality.description:
How right the analysis has been, as far as people have said so: it grows with every prediction looked at.

`correct` and `wrong` are the predictions someone decided on (validated or annotated with this very model, against
invalidated or annotated with another); `pending` are the ones nobody has looked at yet; `missed` are what people
found that the analysis did not (added by hand, or annotated as this model on a prediction of another).
Quality.title: Quality

QualityOverview.description:
The quality of the analysis over every model together, and model by model: of the decisions of one person (what
they said of their own tests), or of everyone's (for an administrator).
QualityOverview.title: QualityOverview

ReindexOut.description: What the worker was asked to index again: the models as they are, and the versions kept of the X they left.
ReindexOut.title: ReindexOut

Review.description:
What the person decides of a prediction. `annotated` names the model it is, one of the analysis, and for the
classification of a page the page of that model (when it has several).
Review.title: Review

RunOut.description:
One use of an analysis. Whoever can open the analysis sees who ran it, when and how it went; what it found is for
the person who ran it alone, an administrator included.
RunOut.title: RunOut

SearchesConsumptionOut.description:
What the searches for similar documents of a person consumed: how many, how many were measured (the others add
nothing), and what.
SearchesConsumptionOut.title: SearchesConsumptionOut

Share.description: Who something is shared with: a person, by e-mail address, or a group, by name.
Share.title: Share

SubModelOut.description: A sub-model, as its parent lists it.
SubModelOut.title: SubModelOut

SuggestedEntity.description: An entity a document suggests by itself, with where it is: to be taken as it is or changed.
SuggestedEntity.title: SuggestedEntity

TemplateMetrics.description: The quality of the analysis on one model: its pages, its elements, and each of its entities.
TemplateMetrics.title: TemplateMetrics

TemplateSharing.description: Who can use a model. The people and groups only count when it is `shared`.
TemplateSharing.title: TemplateSharing

TemplateUpdate.description:
`document_id`: absent keeps the document, null removes it, an id replaces it. `visibility` and `shares`: absent
keeps who the model is shared with.
TemplateUpdate.title: TemplateUpdate

TemplateVersionDetail.description: A version with everything the model was then.
TemplateVersionDetail.title: TemplateVersionDetail

TemplateVersionOut.description: A version of a model, X.Y.Z, as it was saved.
TemplateVersionOut.title: TemplateVersionOut

Zone.description: Fractions (0 to 1) of the page, so that a zone does not depend on the size it is shown at.
Zone.title: Zone

HTTPBearer.description: Keycloak access token. Browser clients authenticate via the BFF session cookie instead.
